trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 3 negation-contrast construction(s): ", not ad-hoc."; ", not a choice." — state the positive claim directly

Four assert-by-denial constructions clustered in the uniqueness subsection ('forced by the structure, not ad-hoc'; 'intrinsic to a ribbon-category / rigid-monoidal structure, not a choice'; 'purely categorical — no arbitrary choices'), i.e. the same quality asserted three times by denying its opposite under a header that already says 'categorical + forced'.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: FIXED (3 deletions, prose only): 'therefore **forced by the structure**, not ad-hoc.' -> 'therefore **forced by the structure**.'; '...rigid-monoidal structure, not a choice.' -> '...rigid-monoidal structure.'; the closing sentence 'So the element is required (unique) and its construction is purely categorical — no arbitrary choices.' deleted (also a thesis restatement). PASSED AS SUBSTANTIVE: 'Mass differences ... come entirely from the descended |tr_M| and brane-tower pieces, not from the Frobenius correction' and 'the bottleneck ... is the size of the explicit dim_q table rather than the proof scheme' — both are the block's actual content.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: No setup-then-reframe. 'This is both a feature and a limitation:' introduces two developed bullets, not a reframe; 'Two answers.' is a structural signpost.
trap-rhetorical-pivot.notes: Minor: 'Two answers.' announces two but the paragraph delivers uniqueness plus a three-sense list; a numbering fix would help the reader.

trap-em-dash.evidence: 11 em-dashes in 1274 words (~1 per 116). Legitimate appositives dominate, but one was an outright punctuation defect and 3-4 append afterthoughts where a semicolon or full stop belongs.
trap-em-dash.notes: FIXED: 'Vortex-dependent corrections (e.g. chirality factors ...' had an unclosed '(e.g.' whose closing paren had been replaced by a dangling em-dash, splitting subject from verb ('corrections ... — are separate structural terms'); changed '(e.g.' -> '— e.g.' so the dash pair closes and parens balance (129/129 verified). PROPOSED (not applied, inside italic statement text): '...matching $\tau(z)$ ... forces $c_\lambda = ...$ — this **is** the definition' -> '; this is the definition'; 'two eigenvalues $(q,-q^{-1})$ — the source of all q-deformation structure' -> ', the source of the q-deformation structure'.

trap-triples.evidence: Five three-item groupings (three senses / three tiers / three specialisations / three consistency checks / three proof-scheme steps). Each enumerates genuinely distinct content — the three senses are the monoidal-morphism origin, the quantum-trace origin and the TQFT cobordism correspondence — so none is a reflex list.
trap-triples.notes: Density note: five triples in one block is at the edge; if any is padded it is 'categorical in three distinct senses', where senses 1 and 3 both reduce to 'built by universal constructions'.

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: Block ends on a technical scope sentence about extending the scheme beyond n=8, not a quotable closer.
trap-closing-aphorism.notes: The closing sentence is damaged by token substitution ('the the formal derivation formalism') — reported under trap-nonspeakable notes and in the anomaly list.
